'''Nishr Base Three''' was one of several bases utilized by the [[Nishr Taskforce]] during the [[Nishr Campaign]]. Little more than a stopover point in the [[Shirshir Desert]], Base Three was used by members of the company when passing through the area to top up their water and batteries, and as a safe spot for a sleep break.<ref name="ROE" />
